value.rationale: L_1 is the first explicit member of a newly introduced family witnessing arbitrarily long nonterminal plateaux in Lie dimension series. Its additive isomorphism type is a canonical, reusable invariant of the concrete witness rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The exact profile reveals that ambient torsion reaches exponent 256 even though the terminal lower-central subgroup has exponent 64; this locates substantial torsion outside the final central layer and gives a concrete structural descriptor for comparison, computation, and future classification of the plateau examples.
